news.title: Messi farewell closes a long, hard-won love story with Argentina

Oct 4 - When Lionel Messi makes his final appearance for Argentina on Tuesday, it will bring to an end a journey that began with the country's football authorities not even knowing his name and evolved into one of the most enduring relationships in sporting history. The farewell against Benin at Buenos Aires' Monumental stadium ends an international career spanning more than two decades, which began with Argentina scrambling to identify a teenage prodigy developing far from home. news.title: Erling Haaland sues Norwegian Air over World Cup advertisement
news.lede: OSLO: Norwegian football star Erling Haaland has taken legal action against Norwegian Air Shuttle, alleging that the airline used elements of his distinctive appearance without permission in a promotional post during the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The dispute centres on a social media advertisement published while Norway was competing at the tournament, marking the country's first World Cup appearance since 1998. According to Norwegian newspaper Verdens Gang (VG), Norwegian Air posted a composite image featuring one of its aircraft with a ponytail resembling Haaland's trademark hairstyle. The post carried the caption, “We’ve never looked more Norwegian”, in a reference to the national team's World Cup campaign.

news.title: Jesse Marsch: ‘We Americans have been inundated with propaganda since we were young’
news.lede: As he prepares to face his home nation, the Canada manager reflects on his adopted country’s soccer, its prime minister, and its place in the world. Peak leaf hasn’t yet arrived in Montreal but the bursts of gold and butterscotch up on the hill that gave this place its name still mushroom out by the hour. Sitting in a glass-panelled hotel mezzanine at the foot of Mount Royal, Canada men’s coach Jesse Marsch has his mind on another harvest. When this extended autumnal international window ends, he will decamp to Italy, where the olive crops at his Tuscan villa are ready for reaping.
